description: Represents a specific instance of an item held by a character in their inventory.

itemDefinitionRef.description: A strong reference to the master item definition (com.cacheblasters.saga.proto.item.definition).

quantity.description: The number of items in this stack. Defaults to 1.

durability.description: The current durability of the item, if applicable.

equipped.description: Indicates if the character is currently equipping this item.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for instance-specific data, like enchantments or unique properties.
